result.title: Temporal Slice Learning for AI-Generated Video Detection with 400$\times$ Fewer FLOPs
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, 18 figures. Project page: https://shangwei5.github.io/TSC-Net/
result.summary: Recent advances in generative video models have improved visual realism, making detection increasingly dependent on subtle temporal inconsistencies. However, these signals are weak and spatially localized, while most of the video content is redundant. This creates a fundamental mismatch: existing detectors rely on heavy backbones to model full videos, which leads to high computational cost and limited scalability. In this work, we rethink AI-generated video detection from a representation perspective. Instead of modeling entire videos, we restructure them into compact temporal slice representations that isolate informative temporal evolution. We introduce a lightweight framework using frequency-aware temporal slice consistency learning, where informative spatial rows and columns are aggregated over time to form slice-domain inputs. This reparameterization suppresses redundant appearance while preserving discriminative temporal dynamics, enabling efficient and targeted detection. By constructing slices from both high- and low-frequency regions, our method exposes complementary temporal artifacts, including unstable details and abnormal motion smoothness. We instantiate this idea in a Temporal Slice Consistency Network, which integrates task-driven slice localization, hierarchical positional encoding, and a lightweight Transformer to model cross-slice and cross-frequency dependencies. We further introduce AI-Artist, a new benchmark with artist-curated videos from recent high-fidelity generators, including Seedance and Kling. Experiments on GenVideo and AI-Artist show that our method achieves strong performance while requiring over 400$\times$ fewer model-forward FLOPs and 3.6$\times$ faster model inference than the strong video-based baseline ReStraV (2.9$\times$ faster end to end, including preprocessing), enabling scalable and practical deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 该文从表示角度重构 AI 生成视频检测：把视频聚合为高、低频区域的时间切片表示，用频率感知的切片一致性学习与轻量 Transformer 建模跨切片依赖，并发布 AI-Artist 基准，在降低 400 倍以上 FLOPs 的同时保持较强检测性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「任务驱动的切片定位」与高低频互补筛选，可能为 LVR 在有限计算下选取视觉证据、抑制冗余外观提供可供核查的线索；但该文面向视频伪造检测而非多模态推理，迁移价值需进一步确认。
